This role is part of the Sales Automation(SA) development team and works closely with the Client Advocacy team, giving you a unique blend of meaningful business impact and deep technical depth.
The Client Advocacy Program sits at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, and Technology at Pega. We are building a best-in-class advocacy program from the ground up, designing the advocate lifecycle, streamlining reference workflows, and developing the platform that powers it all.


Picture Yourself at Pega:
  • You will be a key technical contributor in a high-visibility program, designing, building, and enhancing Pega-based workflows that directly support Pegas sales and marketing strategy.
  • You will work on a greenfield platform where you will contribute to the end-to-end technical implementation across multiple build phases, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with Pega best practices.
  • You will collaborate with business leads, legal, finance, external agency partners, and the Sales Automation development team to deliver a platform that improves how Pega engages, manages, and grows strategic client relationships.
  • You will bring strong Pega development experience to solve complex business problems, improve workflow efficiency, and support a reliable advocacy platform.
  • At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AIenabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decisionmaking across the cloud platform.
  • We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AIgenerated outputsvalidating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacydriven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.


What You'll Do at Pega:
  • Design, develop, and enhance Pega-based case types, workflows, data models, business rules, and automation using Pega platform capabilities and Blueprint.
  • Build and maintain Pega solutions supporting key Client Advocacy processes such as Reference Requests, Advocate Onboarding, Activity Logging, and Pega Points management.
  • Contribute to platform build phases, including sprint planning, development, testing, defect resolution, UAT support, deployment readiness, and post-launch monitoring.
  • Support data migration, data cleansing, deduplication, field mapping, and standardization activities to help establish a reliable advocate database.
  • Create and maintain test scripts, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation to ensure high-quality delivery.
  • Build and support reporting dashboards and KPI tracking to enable monthly and quarterly program readouts.
  • Ensure platform builds follow internal data governance, privacy, security, and GDPR-related requirements for customer and advocate records.
  • Partner with the Sales Automation development team on integration design, technical standards, solution reviews, and roadmap alignment.
  • Support change management efforts by contributing to training materials, adoption communications, user support, and stakeholder office hours.
Troubleshoot issues, analyze root causes, and provide timely resolutions while maintaining strong quality and delivery discipline.


Who You Are:
  • A technically strong Pega developer who can translate business goals into scalable application design and explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A hands-on engineer who is comfortable working across discovery, design, development, testing, release, and support activities.
  • Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity, especially in greenfield environments where processes and requirements may continue to evolve.
  • A collaborative partner who builds trust across cross-functional teams and balances business priorities with technical best practices.
  • Detail-oriented about data quality, workflow design, reusability, performance, and maintainability.
  • A clear and confident communicator who can work effectively with business stakeholders, legal, finance, external agency partners, and engineering teams.
  • Curious about AI-assisted application design and open to using tools such as Pega Blueprint to improve productivity, solution quality, and delivery speed.
  • You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindsetembracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fastchanging technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
  • You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, qualitydriven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


What You've Accomplished:
  • 4+ years of hands-on Pega Platform development experience.
  • Pega CSA certification is required. Pega CSSA strongly preferred.
  • Strong experience building Pega case types, flows, data objects, business rules, decisioning logic, validations, and user interfaces.
  • Hands-on experience with Constellation UI or modern Pega UI implementation patterns.
  • Experience designing and implementing integrations between Pega and external systems using REST APIs, Pega Connect, JSON/XML data formats, and OAuth authentication.
  • Experience working with CRM or sales management platforms such as Sales Automation, Salesforce, or equivalent systems.
  • Good understanding of data migration, data cleansing, deduplication, field mapping, and data standards.
  • SQL experience for data analysis, auditing, reporting, deduplication, or troubleshooting.
  • Experience writing test scripts, defining acceptance criteria, supporting UAT, and resolving defects.
  • Familiarity with data privacy, GDPR, and governance requirements as they apply to customer, contact, and advocate records.
  • Basic understanding of Java, HTML, or related technologies used in Pega customization and troubleshooting.
  • A strong quality mindset with the ability to build reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
Nice to Have
  • Pega CSSA certification or active progress toward CSSA.
  • Exposure to Pega Blueprint and AI-assisted application design.
  • Experience with Power BI or equivalent reporting and dashboard tools.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Automate for workflow automation.
  • SharePoint administration or Microsoft Graph API familiarity.
  • Prior experience in customer advocacy, reference management, sales enablement, CRM, or marketing technology platforms.
  • Exposure to change management practices and supporting business adoption of new platforms.
  • Experience supporting production applications, analysing incidents, and improving platform stability.


Pega Offers You:
  • The opportunity to work on Gartner-recognized, industry-leading technology.
  • A high-visibility greenfield program with direct business and executive impact.
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities, including access to Pega Academy training and certification pathways.
  • An innovative, inclusive, agile, and collaborative work environment where engineering excellence and business impact are equally valued.
  • Competitive global benefits, including pay, bonus incentive, and employee equity programs.
  • An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AIenabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
jobDescription:
Meet Our Team:
Cloud Security Engineering (CSE) is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining security measures to protect organization's cloud infrastructure, applications, and data. We develop security policies, perform assessments, configure tools, and provide guidance to ensure secure cloud environments. CSE partners closely with the Cloud Service Reliability and Cloud Engineering teams to ensure every solution is secure, reliable, available, and observable.


Picture Yourself at Pega:
You will be part of a highly innovative company changing how companies work and optimize their outcomes. In this role you will be part of a highly collaborative team that is well versed and skilled in their space. You will be an adaptive/flexible change agent driving data driven decisioning while seeing the benefits of your hard work turn into business outcomes.


What You'll Do at Pega:
As a Senior Cloud Security Engineer at Pega, you will play a critical role in protecting our cloud platforms, applications, and infrastructure at scale. You will focus on building security-first solutions across AWS/GCP, Kubernetes environments, and endpoint detection platforms, while driving automation through modern engineering practices.
Your responsibilities will include:
Design and implement cloud-native security controls across AWS and GCP, leveraging services such as IAM, GuardDuty, AWS Config and GCP SCC.
Build and operate Security as a Service platforms to enable scalable, reusable security capabilities as part of provisioning.
Develop automation/service using Golang and Python to improve Pega Cloud security posture.
Deploy, integrate, and optimise EDR/XDR solutions (Trend Micro, CrowdStrike) to enhance endpoint and workload protection.
Secure and operate containerised workloads and Kubernetes environments, ensuring best practices in runtime protection and network controls.
Configure security alerts, investigate incidents, and lead response activities across cloud and endpoint environments.
Define and maintain security policies, standards, and guardrails aligned to DevSecOps and enterprise security frameworks.
Collaborate with engineering teams to embed security into CI/CD pipelines and SDLC processes.
Solve complex security challenges and drive end-to-end implementation of scalable solutions.
Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices in cloud and endpoint security.


Who You Are:
Strong expertise in AWS security services (IAM, VPC security, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, etc.) and working knowledge of GCP security.
Hands-on experience with EDR/XDR tools such as Trend Micro or CrowdStrike for threat detection and response.
Solid experience securing Kubernetes and container platforms (runtime security, network policies, image scanning).
Proficient in development and scripting using Golang and Python, with a strong focus on security automation.
Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools like Terraform and CloudFormation.
Familiarity with security tooling including vulnerability scanners, CSPM, storage scanning, and continuous monitoring solutions.
Strong understanding of DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Git, etc.), and secure SDLC practices.
Good knowledge of Linux systems, networking, and cloud-native architectures.
Strong analytical mindset with excellent collaboration and communication skills.


What You've Accomplished:
Required Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
4+ years of experience in cloud security engineering, with strong exposure to AWS (and/or GCP).
Proven experience working with EDR/XDR platforms (Trend Micro, CrowdStrike or similar).
Hands-on experience in cloud security engineering, Kubernetes security, and container ecosystems.
Strong programming and automation skills using Golang and Python.
Experience integrating security into DevOps pipelines and CI/CD workflows.
Experience building or integrating systems using APIs and microservices architectures.
Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CloudFormation).
Desired Qualifications
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and platforms (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar) to improve productivity, code quality, and security automation.
Experience with SIEM/log management platforms and security analytics.
Exposure to advanced detection engineering, threat hunting, or security automation frameworks.
Certifications such as AWS Security Specialty, CCSP, or GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer.
Awareness of compliance frameworks and security governance standards.


Pega Offers You:
  • Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities
  • An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment
  • Competitive global benefits program inclusive ofpay + bonus incentive, employee equity in the company

title: Lead AI Engineer
jobDescription:
ROLE SUMMARY
As a Lead AI Engineer, you will own the architecture and delivery of GenAI-based systems that integrate large language models (LLMs), multi-agent workflows, and embedding-powered retrieval solutions. You will guide cross-functional pods, define engineering standards, and drive innovation through scalable, production-grade intelligent applications. You will lead a team of associates both functionally and admin responsibilities.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Architect enterprise-grade GenAI systems using modular LLM APIs, agent orchestration frameworks, and embedding pipelines
  • Design and implement autonomous agent workflows with context management, multi-agent coordination, and task delegation
  • Optimize performance, latency, and accuracy through experimentation with prompt strategies, retrieval layers, and caching logic
  • Lead solution reviews, enforce prompt safety and governance, and ensure alignment with security protocols
  • Collaborate with platform, product, and engineering leads to define reusable patterns and scalable AI capabilities
  • Guide engineering pods on GenAI design principles, system reliability, and prompt lifecycle management
  • Build and maintain reusability assets SDKs, templates, shared agent logic to accelerate delivery velocity across teams
  • Stay up to date with advancements in LLM tooling, orchestration abstractions, and prompt optimization techniques


Required Qualifications
  • 6 to 8+ years of experience in software, AI, or ML engineering roles, including significant experience designing, delivering, and operating production-grade GenAI or agentic AI applications
  • Proven experience leading the technical delivery of LLM-powered products or agent-based solutions, including solution design, engineering guidance, and operational readiness
  • Strong technical foundation in Python and modern backend engineering patterns, with practical experience building AI-enabled application services and APIs
  • Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent platforms and orchestration frameworks, including real-world use of LLM APIs, prompt workflows, tool calling, and agent coordination
  • Strong experience designing and implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector-based patterns using platforms such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or equivalent
  • Experience building and deploying cloud-native AI services using technologies such as Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, FastAPI, Docker, Azure DevOps, GitHub, or equivalent engineering and deployment platforms
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD, containerization, automated testing, and production deployment practices for AI-driven systems
  • Practical experience with observability and operational tooling such as Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, Datadog, New Relic, or equivalent, including monitoring of reliability, latency, and cost
  • Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent (A2A) interaction patterns, or similar context-sharing and distributed agent communication approaches
  • Strong ownership mindset across the full SDLC, including design, build, deployment, support, reliability improvement, and long-term maintainability
  • Proven ability to raise engineering quality through code reviews, technical mentoring, design guidance, and reuse of shared patterns and components
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, architecture, product, and platform teams




Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience leading the design or implementation of agentic AI workflows involving multi-step reasoning, tool orchestration, and reusable orchestration patterns
  • Experience with Microsoft AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI / Copilot Studio, or equivalent platforms used for enterprise AI solution development and experimentation
  • Familiarity with enterprise integration and application ecosystems, including AI integration with APIs, workflow platforms, and downstream business systems
  • Experience contributing to reusable GenAI accelerators, prompt libraries, orchestration templates, internal AI developer platforms, or engineering toolkits
  • Familiarity with AI governance, safety, observability, and cost-management tooling, including token usage analytics, quality evaluation, and guardrail implementation
  • Experience supporting technical direction for other engineers through architecture reviews, implementation guidance, and technical mentoring
  • Ability to communicate complex technical decisions clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience operating in a build-own-operate product environment with strong expectations around reliability, supportability, and continuous improvement

descriptionFromApi:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We''re all in on this mission. If you are too, let''s talk.
We are looking for an experienced Principal Software Engineer to work on our next-generation Imports Platform team. Imports Platform team is leading a strategic initiative to modernize Okta''s identity lifecycle management capabilities by architecting and migrating from a legacy monolithic system to a highly scalable, distributed microservices platform. This critical service orchestrates the importing, syncing, and provisioning of identities and access policiesusers, groups, roles, entitlementsfrom external directory services including Active Directory, Office 365, and LDAP-based systems.
As a Principal Software Engineer on the Imports Platform team, you will be a cross-team technical leader who takes difficult, ambiguously defined problems and drives them from ideation through production impact without oversight. You will own projects from zero to landingdefining scope, planning execution, making architectural decisions, and articulating measurable impact across the group. You will generate novel solutions to complex distributed systems challenges, guide the team''s technical direction, and get stakeholder buy-in on architectural strategy spanning multiple teams.
Your sphere of influence extends beyond the Imports Platform team to adjacent teams within the group and cross-functional partners in Product, Design, and SRE. You will participate in group-level strategy, break down strategic initiatives into actionable technical milestones, and drive cross-team operational excellence. You''ll tackle challenges including massive-scale batch processing, real-time synchronization, user matching algorithms, and identity resolution serving thousands of enterprise customers.
This role requires exceptional technical depth, strategic thinking, and the ability to independently navigate ambiguity while balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform health. You will improve engineering culture, mentor staff and senior engineers, self-direct cross-functional collaborations, and help shape the future of Okta''s Imports platform and identity lifecycle management capabilities.
This is a hybrid position requiring a blend of remote and in-office collaboration.
Job Duties and Responsibilities
Execution and Impact
- Own projects from zero to landing, including ideation, planning, scoping, design, implementation, deployment, and clear articulation of project impact
- Generate design ideas and expert solutions for ambiguous, cross-team problems, taking complete ownership from conception through production and customer impact
- Design and architect core, high-performance, scalable distributed systems with full ownership of all production aspects (scalability, reliability, monitoring, alerting, resource efficiency, automated testing, documentation, production hygiene, and support processes)
- Research, determine, and articulate multiple design options balancing short and long-term needs; use domain experience to make judgment calls when there are no obvious solutions
- Lead product delivery discussions and obtain stakeholder buy-in on technical design and architecture across group stakeholders
- Drive the migration strategy from monolithic to microservices architecture, planning and scoping the effort across multiple teams and aligning project members towards shared goals and standards
- Use spikes, proof of concepts, external research, and metrics to make informed decisions on technical direction
- Interface extensively with cross-functional teams (Architects, QA, Product, Technical Support, Documentation, UX, and SRE) through self-directed collaborations to deliver comprehensive import and sync solutions
Operational Excellence
- Independently troubleshoot complex production incidents spanning cross-team within the group; ask the right questions to narrow scope and provide immediate and future remediation steps
- Identify systemic operational gaps and initiate cross-team improvement efforts, such as driving down common alert types across the group
- Drive improvements in observability, monitoring, alerting, and production support capabilities across the Imports Platform and adjacent services
- Perform root cause analysis on cross-team incidents and drive systemic improvements to prevent recurrence
### Engineering Craft
- Relentlessly drive the most important velocity and operations-impacting projects for the team (automation, support processes, reliability, monitoring, CI/CD) while working with engineering leadership
- Proactively identify process, service, product, and system debt across the team and adjacent areas; work with teams to prioritize and resolve them
- Conduct code reviews with focus on systems design, reliability, performance, scalability, security, and maintainabilityleading by example on review quality
- Anticipate, communicate, and manage technical risks in collaboration with other teams and departments
- Use data and metrics to drive technical decisions and validate the impact of architectural changes
Leadership
- Self-direct cross-functional collaborations as required to meet project goals; demonstrate empathy across all EPD functions to shape excellent product deliverables
- Work with stakeholders (Product Owner, PM, Architect, Manager) to help convert group strategy into actionable milestones
- Participate in group strategy discussions; break down strategic initiatives into tactical execution plans
- Play an important role in decision-making and making judgment calls that benefit the entire team and group
- Lead implementation of solutions while delegating and guiding colleagues on sub-components
- Take ownership and demonstrate strong independenceprojects stay on track without steering once started
- Demonstrate Okta''s customer-focus culture by working with Field, CSMs, and EEP to identify patterns in recurring customer issues and socialize product improvements
Citizenship
- Consistently set aside time for mentorship, collaboration, and technical leadership; guide others in engineering culture and best practices

jobDescription:
Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits, not to mention a Flex Work approach that is truly flexible to support where, when, and how you do your best work.
Dolby is looking for a talented Senior Foundational Audio AI Researcher to join Dolby s research efforts to drive innovation for audio, signal processing, perception, and application of AI in the audio domain. You will drive key innovations for Dolby s core business which allow Dolby and its customers to build products that push the boundaries of sound and multimedia experiences.
You will focus on the creation and implementation of audio and multimedia signal processing technologies from the underlying theoretical concepts to the development of prototypes and demonstrators, with the goal to create new experiences, and explore new horizons in the fields of audio and multimedia signal processing and AI based generation/processing/ synthesis.
What you will do:
You will push the boundaries of the state-of-the-art in audio, video, and multi-modal technologies. The ideal candidate would have a strong background in deep learning, both in terms of conceptual understanding, as well as practical experience. A core aspect of this role involves being able to keep up to date with the literature, implement, and innovate with the bleeding edge in generative models, self-supervised learning, and multi-modal learning. With the explosion of audio, video, and multi-modal foundational models, you will partner closely with Dolby s worldwide AI research staff, which actively pursues the integration of such models into audio and media experiences. You will be able to hit the ground running, innovate, and contribute to such projects. Consequently, experience with language models, question answering, vision-language models, captioning, etc. would be highly beneficial.

Consequently, knowledge or experience in any/all of the following are helpful:
  • Diffusion, autoregressive, or other generative models.
  • Self-supervised, contrastive learning, auto-encoders.
  • Audio, image, or text applications Source separation, text-to-speech, music synthesis, image segmentation, image captioning, question answering, language models, etc.
Main Responsibilities:
  • Partner closely with other domain experts to refine and execute Dolby s technical strategy in artificial intelligence and machine learning.
  • Use deep learning to create new solutions (including foundation models) and enhance existing applications.
  • Push the state-of-the-art and develop intellectual property.
  • Transfer technology to product groups and draft patent applications.
  • Advise internal leaders on recent deep learning advancements in the industry and academia to further influence research direction and business decisions.
Requirements:
  • Ph.D. in Computer Science or similar field.
  • A strong background in deep learning, both in terms of conceptual understanding, as well as practical experience.
  • Knowledge in audio, video, or text processing is desirable.
  • Strong publication record, with publications in major machine learning conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML). Publications in top domain-specific conferences is desirable (e.g., ACL, CVPR, ICASSP)
  • Good knowledge about current machine learning literature.
  • Highly skilled in Python and one or more popular deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
  • Ability to envision new technologies and turn them into innovative products. Creativity.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.

What We Do

Mojro is a logistics automation platform solving NP-Hard route and load optimization problems at scale - for enterprise customers like Asian Paints, Cargill, Unilever, and PG. Our algorithms move goods across India smarter, faster, and with fewer kilometres wasted. If you have never seen a constraint-satisfaction engine running at 2,500 RPS on a Tuesday morning, you will at Mojro.


Why This Role Exists

We are not hiring a senior developer with a fancy title. We are hiring a leader who can do the work, explain the work, improve the work, and pull a team of sharp engineers toward harder problems - all at once.

You will join as one of a small number of Staff Engineers who collectively own the engineering quality bar at Mojro. You will report to the Head of Engineering, work directly with Principal Architects, and your decisions will ship to production.

The Person We Are Looking For

We do not manage by title. We build by trust, move by clarity, and grow by challenge. Here is what matters to us more than any skill checklist:

Still Writes Code

You are not done with the keyboard. You review PRs with comments, not just approvals. Your opinions on system design come from having built the system.

Sees the Whole Board

You track technical debt, delivery timelines, team health, and customer impact - simultaneously. You know which one to pull first.

AI-Native Builder

You actively use AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code), measure their impact on your team, and make informed bets on where AI accelerates and where it misleads.

Radically Candid

You challenge ideas in the room, not in the corridor. You give feedback that is direct but kind - to your team and upward. You can disagree and commit.

Runs on Objectives

You break ambiguity into clear goals, communicate them with context, and hold yourself and your team accountable. You do not need a manager to tell you what matters.

Builder of Builders

You are remembered by the engineers who grew under you. You create pull, not pressure. Your best move is making your team not need you.

What You Will Own

Technical Leadership - Lead a pod of 5-8 engineers across backend and frontend. Architect and review, not just approve.

Delivery - Drive sprint cadence, unblock bottlenecks, and ship features that enterprise customers stake their operations on.

AI Tooling Adoption - Champion the use of AI coding tools across your team. Measure productivity. Present findings. Drive decisions.

Quality Reliability - Own the teams quality bar - automated test coverage, performance benchmarks, RCA rigour.

Mentorship - Run 1:1s with intent. Grow senior engineers toward staff, mid-level toward senior. Make learning a team ritual.

Cross-Team Influence - Work with Principal Architects, Product, and CSM to shape roadmap, surface technical risks, and defend the right calls.


The Stack

You do not need to know all of this. You need to lead engineers who do, and you need to learn fast what you do not.

WORK THAT IS HARD AND MEANINGFUL

title: Microsoft Relationship Manager
jobDescription:
There is an immediate need for a Microsoft Relationship Manager located in India (Delhi NCR or Chennai preferred; open to candidates across India) at SupraITS. If you re a senior professional who truly understands Microsoft partner programs and wants to own a direct Microsoft relationship end to end, then this position is for you.

ABOUT SUPRA ITS

Founded in 1999, Supra ITS has grown into a globally trusted IT partner, delivering world-class Managed IT, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Application Services, and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) Services. Headquartered in Mississauga, Supra ITS operates with 650+ employees worldwide, including Network Operations Centers (NOCs) in Canada and India, ensuring 24/7 IT support and seamless service delivery.

Supra ITS provides a full spectrum of IT solutions, including server and network management, private cloud, disaster recovery, service desk support, and advanced security services. With a security-first approach and SLA-driven commitments, Supra ITS takes complete ownership of IT services, allowing clients to focus on growth while ensuring uninterrupted operations.

A vendor of established track record, Supra ITS is dedicated to long-term client success through tailored, scalable IT solutions. Canon Canada s strategic investment in Supra ITS strengthens this commitment by integrating Canon s cutting-edge technologies with Supra s agile IT services. This partnership fosters innovation, enhances efficiency, and accelerates digital transformation, providing customers with superior IT solutions that are scalable, secure, and customer centric.

TEAM OVERVIEW

This is your opportunity to join a dynamic company with a team that works very well together and has solid organized structures in place. Supra has become a Microsoft Direct (Tier-1) CSP Partner and is investing in its Microsoft practice across Modern Work, Security, Azure, and Copilot. You will be part of a growing team and an evolving company, working closely with leadership in Canada and India.

YOU ARE!

You are someone who knows the Microsoft partner ecosystem inside out. You have lived in Partner Center, you know how CSP direct billing works, and you can explain incentives, designations, and co-sell motions without opening a manual. You take pride in turning Microsoft s programs into real, measurable business value.

You are a relationship builder. You are comfortable engaging Microsoft account teams, distributors, and internal executives alike. You chase actions, keep cadences alive, and make sure nothing Microsoft offers Supra is left on the table.

You re not just joining a team-you re becoming the face of Supra s Microsoft alliance, in a company that values collaboration, continuous improvement, and a shared commitment to excellence.

The Microsoft Relationship Manager is responsible for owning and growing Supra s direct Microsoft relationship following our transition to Microsoft Direct (Tier-1) CSP Partner status. This role owns the complete operating rhythm around Partner Center, CSP program compliance, Microsoft Commerce Incentives, co-op/MDF funding, Solutions Partner designations, certifications, co-sell motions, and executive reporting. The Microsoft Relationship Manager acts as the bridge between Microsoft, distributors, and Supra s sales, technical, finance, and leadership teams. The role reports to the Director of Product Management, based in Canada.

This is a hybrid role based in India. Delhi NCR or Chennai is preferred; strong candidates from other locations across India will also be considered. As the reporting manager is based in Canada, this role requires regular working-hours overlap with morning EST (approximately 6:30 PM - 10:30 PM IST).

Key Responsibilities Microsoft Alliance Relationship Management

  • Act as Supra s single point of contact for Microsoft - partner development managers, field sellers, and distributor/indirect contacts.
  • Build and maintain a Microsoft contact map, engagement calendar, and escalation log.
  • Prepare and run Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with Microsoft, including agendas, pre-reads, action trackers, and follow-ups.
  • Represent Supra in Microsoft partner events, program briefings, and community forums.

Partner Center Direct CSP Operations

  • Own day-to-day Partner Center administration: user access, role assignments, benefits activation, program enrollments, and support tickets.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with Microsoft Direct CSP (direct-bill) requirements, including revenue thresholds, support plans, and security requirements (MFA, GDAP, CPOR/PAL associations).
  • Manage relationships and commercial terms with distributors and Microsoft for licensing motions, including New Commerce Experience (NCE) transitions.

Incentives, Funding Rebates

  • Own end-to-end management of Microsoft Commerce Incentives: enrollment, eligibility, claims, documentation, payout tracking, and finance reconciliation.
  • Identify and capture co-op/MDF funds, workshop funding, and other Microsoft partner investments.
  • Maintain an incentives and funding tracker with clear visibility of earned, claimed, pending, and missed amounts.

Designations, Certifications Enablement

  • Drive progress towards Solutions Partner designations and specializations across Modern Work, Security, Azure, and Business Applications as applicable.
  • Maintain the certification tracker and internal skilling calendar; coordinate monthly sales and technical enablement for Modern Work, Security, Azure, Copilot, licensing, and Partner Center workflows.
  • Work with delivery and HR teams to plan certification paths that protect designation renewals.

Co-sell Go-to-Market

  • Manage co-sell readiness: referrals, solution listings, marketplace presence, and Microsoft field alignment.
  • Track co-sell opportunities, campaign activity, solution plays, and Microsoft-funded customer workshops.
  • Partner with sales leadership to convert Microsoft programs into pipeline and revenue.

Executive Reporting Governance

Maintain a concise monthly executive dashboard and action tracker covering, e.g.:

  • Incentive earnings, claims, and payout status.
  • Solutions Partner designation and partner capability score progress.
  • Certification and enablement completion.
  • Co-op/MDF funding utilization.
  • Co-sell pipeline and referral activity.
  • Open Microsoft actions and escalations.

Qualifications Skills

Education Experience

  • Bachelor s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years of experience in the Microsoft partner ecosystem - partner/alliance management, partner programs, CSP operations, or vendor management at an MSP, CSP, LSP, distributor, or Microsoft itself.
  • Hands-on experience operating a Microsoft CSP practice; direct-bill (Tier-1) experience is strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of managing incentives, funding, and designation programs with measurable results.

Microsoft Program Knowledge

  • Deep working knowledge of Microsoft Partner Center, the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program, Solutions Partner designations, and specializations.
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Commerce Incentives, co-op/MDF, CPOR/PAL, co-sell, and marketplace programs.
  • Solid grasp of Microsoft licensing (CSP/NCE) and the Modern Work, Security, Azure, and Copilot portfolios.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent relationship-building, communication, and executive-presentation skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills (Excel / Power BI) with disciplined documentation and follow-through.
  • Self-driven owner s mindset - comfortable running a cadence, chasing actions, and working across time zones.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Were hiring a hands-on Senior Backend Engineer to take ownership of production backend systems. Your primary language can be Python or Node.js - we care about engineering depth, not which syntax you think in.

This is a high-ownership seat: youll make architecture decisions, scale live systems, integrate and evaluate LLMs in real products, guide a small development team, and communicate directly with stakeholders. There is no architect above you catching your mistakes - the judgment is the job.

Were looking for someone who understands their language beneath the framework, has scaled real systems on AWS, and treats LLMs as an engineering discipline - evaluations, structured outputs, cost control - rather than magic.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own backend systems end-to-end: design, build, deploy, monitor, and scale.

  • Architect and maintain APIs and data stores that hold up as load grows - parallelism, queuing, caching, and cost are your daily concerns.

  • Build and improve LLM-powered features: prompt/output contracts, evaluation sets, accuracy improvement, and API cost tracking.

  • Make and document architecture decisions (ADRs); design out single points of knowledge, not just single points of failure.

  • Guide delivery for a small team (4-6 developers): sprint planning, backlog refinement, breaking user stories into pickable tasks, code review, and mentoring.

  • Communicate directly with stakeholders: estimates, trade-offs, timelines, and the occasional hard conversation.

  • Run structured RD: when asked to evaluate a new tool or approach, you return with clear criteria, results from real data, and a written recommendation.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of backend engineering in Python or Node.js - genuinely, beneath the framework.

  • Framework experience (Django/FastAPI or Express/NestJS) is expected; framework-only experience is not enough.

  • Production API experience - design, versioning, security, and debugging slow endpoints with evidence rather than guesses.

  • Technical leadership - you can take a user story and break it into tasks a team can pick up, you document as you go (ADRs, runbooks) so knowledge never lives only in your head, and you can explain a technical decision to a non-technical audience and stand behind it.

  • Scaling scars - youve watched a database fall over before the app servers did, and you know what to do about it (and it isnt "upgrade the instance").

  • AWS fundamentals - Lambda and its real limits, SQS/SNS/EventBridge, S3-driven workflows, IAM, and cost awareness. Youve been paged for something you built.

  • LLM application experience - structured outputs, evaluation sets, handling non-determinism, rate limits, and API cost as a first-class metric.

  • AI-assisted development maturity - you use modern coding tools daily and can explain every line you merge.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with both Python and Node.js.

  • Azure Cloud experience.

  • Vector search experience.

  • GraphQL in production.

  • Frontend working knowledge.

Job Description - RPA Managed Services Lead (UiPath)

Job Title: RPA Managed Services Lead - UiPath
Department: Intelligent Automation
Location: Bangalore / Mohali / Vizag / Nashik / Delhi
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: On-site
Working Days: Monday to Friday
Reporting To: Head of IT Managed Services

About Valenta

Valenta is a global business solutions provider specializing in consulting, digital transformation, and managed services. We empower businesses to optimize operations, reduce costs, and achieve sustainable growth through strategic outsourcing and automation. With a global delivery model and deep expertise across industries, we deliver cutting-edge solutions that help clients transform and scale their operations efficiently.

Our Vision: Making life easier, one intelligent automation at a time, to empower people and businesses alike.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced RPA Managed Services Lead (UiPath) to lead our UiPath Managed Services team and ensure seamless operation of enterprise automation solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in UiPath along with hands-on experience managing production support, bot monitoring, client engagement, incident management, and service delivery.

This role requires someone who can lead support operations, optimize bot performance, manage SLAs, mentor team members, and work closely with global clients to maximize the value of their automation investments.

Key Responsibilities

Managed Services Operations

  • Lead daily monitoring and support of UiPath automation environments.
  • Ensure bots are running successfully and proactively resolve production issues.
  • Monitor bot execution, queues, schedules, and unattended automation performance.
  • Perform health checks and maintain high availability of automation services.

Incident Service Management

  • Manage production incidents, service requests, and support tickets.
  • Ensure timely resolution of issues while meeting defined SLAs and turnaround times.
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement preventive measures.
  • Maintain proper documentation of incidents, fixes, and operational procedures.

Client Engagement

  • Act as the primary point of contact for managed services clients.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders and provide proactive support.
  • Conduct regular client reviews and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through excellent service delivery.

Bot Performance Optimization

  • Analyze bot performance and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Improve automation stability, efficiency, and resource utilization.
  • Optimize bot schedules, queues, and license usage.
  • Coordinate with development teams for enhancement requests and production fixes.

Infrastructure Platform Management

  • Manage UiPath Orchestrator environments and bot deployments.
  • Monitor VM utilization, robot availability, and license allocation.
  • Support infrastructure upgrades, maintenance activities, and platform enhancements.
  • Ensure automation environments comply with organizational standards and security policies.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor the Managed Services support team.
  • Allocate work, monitor performance, and ensure quality service delivery.
  • Coach team members on troubleshooting, best practices, and operational excellence.
  • Foster a collaborative and customer-focused culture.

Reporting Governance

  • Prepare operational dashboards and service reports.
  • Track KPIs, SLAs, incident trends, bot utilization, and system performance.
  • Present performance reports and improvement recommendations to internal leadership and clients.
  • Drive continuous service improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 8+ years of overall experience in Robotic Process Automation (RPA).
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in UiPath Managed Services, Production Support, or Automation Support.
  • Strong experience supporting enterprise automation environments.
  • Experience working with global clients and managing service delivery.
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes and support operations is an added advantage.

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with UiPath Orchestrator.
  • Experience managing unattended robots, queues, assets, triggers, and schedules.
  • Good understanding of UiPath Automation Cloud and On-Premise environments.
  • Knowledge of robot deployment, package management, and release processes.
  • Experience with bot monitoring, production support, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of exception handling and logging frameworks.
  • Knowledge of SQL databases and basic database troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience with Windows Servers, Virtual Machines, and infrastructure monitoring.
  • Understanding of license management and robot utilization.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and version control tools is an advantage.

Preferred Skills

  • UiPath Certified Professional (Associate or Advanced).
  • Experience working with enterprise automation environments.
  • Knowledge of Document Understanding (DU), AI Center, and Integration Service is desirable.
  • Experience supporting cloud-based automation platforms.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, Jira, or other ITSM ticketing tools.

Leadership Soft Skills

  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Customer-first mindset with strong service orientation.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong ownership, accountability, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to mentor, coach, and develop team members.
  • Excellent organizational and reporting skills.

Job Description

Job Purpose

Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) presents a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and solve complex business challenges in the ficial sector. This Senior QA Engineer role is focused on Market Data applications and plays a key role in validating high-quality, reliable market data solutions that support trading, reporting, compliance, and downstream consumer workflows.

The Senior QA Engineer will be responsible for designing, executing, and improving test coverage for Market Data systems. The role requires strong domain understanding of market data workflows, feed processing, reference data, trading lifecycle impacts, and validation of data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and downstream publishing.

This position requires strong analytical skills, hands-on technical troubleshooting, excellent communication, and the ability to independently drive QA activities with minimal technical supervision.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior QA Engineer with strong experience in Market Data systems and ficial markets QA. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience validating market data feeds, reference data changes, symbol/security lifecycle events, data dissemination, and regression coverage across complex trading and market data platforms. The successful candidate will work across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), partner closely with development, product, operations, and business teams, and contribute to quality delivery in a fast-paced, team-based environment.

The role includes creating and executing test plans, test scenarios, and test cases; identifying and reporting defects; validating fixes; supporting production/UAT changes; and continuously improving QA processes, automation coverage, and test efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, and test cases for Market Data applications, including functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and data validation coverage.
  • Validate market data feed processing, reference data updates, symbol/security lifecycle events, trading session behavior, and downstream data publishing to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Perform detailed validation of market data outputs across environments using logs, database queries, reports, and application-level checks.
  • Identify, document, and report software defects using Jira or equivalent defect tracking tools, and collaborate with developers and product teams through resolution and retesting.
  • Review and triage test failures, analyze logs, isolate root cause, and verify fixes across QA, UAT, and production-like environments.
  • Contribute to automation coverage by developing, maintaining, and executing automated tests for regression and recurring validation activities.
  • Ensure new features, enhancements, reference data changes, and bug fixes do not negatively impact existing Market Data functionality or downstream consumers.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams involved in product delivery, including development, product management, operations, support, and business stakeholders.
  • Maintain clear and concise documentation of test plans, test cases, execution results, defect evidence, and sign-off summaries.
  • Participate in production change support, UAT validation, issue investigation, and service restoration activities when required.
  • Stay current with QA engineering practices, market data testing approaches, automation frameworks, and ficial technology trends.

Knowledge and Experience

  • Solid hands-on experience in Market Data or related ficial data systems, including validation of feed ingestion, data transformation, dissemination, reporting, and downstream consumption.
  • Strong understanding of capital markets, trading workflows, reference data, security master concepts, symbols, instruments, sessions, and lifecycle events affecting market data behavior.
  • Experience validating market data quality dimensions such as accuracy, completeness, timeliness, sequencing, entitlement/availability, and consistency across systems.
  • Proficient in Linux command-line usage, including log navigation, file handling, process monitoring, grep/awk/sed usage, and troubleshooting test environment issues.
  • Hands-on experience writing and executing SQL queries for test data validation, database state analysis, reconciliation, and result verification across QA environments.
  • Experience with functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, smoke, and production/UAT validation in ficial or trading application environments.
  • Ability to analyze complex defects, identify edge cases, provide clear evidence, and communicate impact to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with defect tracking and project management tools such as Jira, including managing the full bug lifecycle from identification through resolution verification.
  • Experience with automation frameworks, test data preparation, regression execution, and continuous improvement of repeatable QA processes.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and documentation skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, globally distributed team environment.

Preferred Knowledge and Experience

  • Good knowledge of market data protocols, feed handlers, data distribution platforms, or exchange market data concepts.
  • Experience with XDP, multicast/real-time feeds, replay/recovery concepts, order book/quote/trade data validation, or similar market data technologies is a plus.
  • Exposure to FIX protocol, trading systems, Options or Equities platforms, and exchange workflows is an added advantage.
  • Experience supporting production changes, UAT testing, release validation, debugging production issues, and providing impact analysis for data or reference data changes.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to improve QA productivity, including test case generation, log analysis, root cause investigation, and intelligent defect triage.
  • Results-driven mindset with strong ownership, attention to detail, ability to meet tight schedules, and commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes for internal customers.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Coupa Techno-Functional Consultant specializing in Coupa Risk Assess (CRA) to maintain, optimize, and expand our Coupa Procurement environment. In this position, you will bridge technical design and functional configuration across key modules, including Procurement, Invoicing, Sourcing, Inventory, Contracts, and CRA. You will design system enhancements, build custom reporting, resolve technical issues, and partner with internal business teams and Coupa Support to ensure optimal platform performance, reliability, and user experience.

Responsibilities

  • Drive System Optimization: Support, enhance, and scale the Coupa Procurement environment, specializing in Coupa Risk Assess CRA and core P2P/S2P modules.
  • Bridge Technical Functional Needs: Translate business requirements into robust system configurations, smart forms, approval workflows, and custom fields.
  • Build Integrations Workflows: Design and maintain Coupa API integrations and middleware connections (MuleSoft, Boomi, SnapLogic) with enterprise ERPs.
  • Develop Custom Analytics: Leverage Coupa Advanced Reporting, Insights, and SQL querying to deliver actionable procurement and financial data reports.
  • Manage Platform Issues: Troubleshoot system bugs, analyze API logs, and partner with Coupa Support to ensure seamless system performance.
  • Streamline Supplier Operations: Oversee Supplier Enablement workflows and manage configurations within the Coupa Supplier Portal.
  • Enhance System Capabilities: Design, test, and deploy platform enhancements, custom reports, and automated process improvements.
  • Engage Stakeholders: Collaborate closely with cross-functional business teams, technical leads, and vendors to streamline procurement operations.

Who You Are

You're good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused - someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you're open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience as a Coupa Techno-Functional Consultant across core P2P, S2P, and contract lifecycle management processes.
  • Specialized Coupa Expertise: Strong proficiency in Coupa Risk Assess (CRA), Spend Guard, Smart Forms, Approvals, and the overall Coupa Data Model.
  • API Middleware Integration: Proven track record with Coupa API integrations, middleware tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, SnapLogic), and major ERP systems (D365 FO, Oracle Cloud).
  • Advanced Reporting SQL: Expertise in Coupa Advanced Reporting, Insights, BI tools, and complex SQL querying for procurement data analysis.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Strong ability to debug Coupa API logs, resolve technical issues, and partner with Coupa Support.
  • Supplier Workflows: Hands-on experience managing the Coupa Supplier Portal and Supplier Enablement workflows.
  • Process Automation: Familiarity with RPA tools for procurement process automation.
  • Certifications Soft Skills: Strong stakeholder management skills, with Coupa Platform Administration or Technical Integration certification preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with D365 FO, Oracle Cloud Procurement alongside Coupa.
  • Knowledge of RPA (Robotic Process Automation) tools for process automation within Coupa.
  • Experience in Coupa Risk Assess, Spend Guard, and Risk Assessments.
  • Certification in Coupa Platform Administration or Technical Integration.

Job Summary

As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.

As a GIS Senior Associate, you will support ERM s global consulting delivery by providing geospatial technical solutions for environmental and sustainability projects worldwide. You will work within the team of geospatial professionals and as GIS Senior Associate your role will be to blend geospatial expertise with environmental consulting, offering opportunities to work on multidisciplinary projects in site investigation and remediation, capital project delivery, due diligence, and environmental planning.

What you will bring

  • Good command on fundamentals of Geospatial technology and techniques, geo analytics and integrated spatial data collection, management and visualization skills.
  • Proficiency in industry standard geospatial software and technologies.
  • Ability to obtain, process, and interpret geospatial data and integrate spatial and non-spatial data for environmental studies.
  • Attention to detail and problem-solving skills, using interdisciplinary perspectives on how to use spatial data to solve environmental studies challenges.

Essential qualifications, skills competencies

  • Bachelor s or Master degree in Geoinformatics, Geography, Environmental Sciences, Geology, Environmental Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3-4 years of professional experience in Geospatial or environmental consulting. Proficiency in Esri s ArcGIS Suite of Technologies - ArcGIS Desktop (ArcGIS Pro) and its extension tools, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, Field Survey and mobile applications such as Survey 123, Field Maps and experience with AutoCAD Map and Civil 3D is a plus.
  • Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, Oracle, or SQL for automation, custom tool and GIS application development.
  • Good understanding of geodatabase management, including domains, subtypes, and feature class operations.
  • Skilled in projections/coordinate systems, geoprocessing tools (joins, merges, topology, dissolves), symbology configuration, labelling, annotation, and definition queries.
  • Good communication skills and attention to detail, with a focus on professional presentation of maps and visualizations.
  • Ability to work effectively in team environments and deliver quality projects on time and within budget.

Preferred skills competencies

  • Remote Sensing and Digital Image processing.
  • Advanced geospatial modelling and cloud computing and spatial analysis using GEE.
  • Knowledge and experience on GeoAI applications, especially ESRI s pretrained models and the AI model training process for tailored solutions and needs.

Key responsibilities

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure Geospatial data and map deliverables meet or exceed client expectations.
  • Plan, design, implement, and maintain large, complex, multiyear GIS projects.
  • Organize and manage project data, analysis, and mapping following company protocols and industry best practices.
  • Design and produce maps in ArcGIS platform for technical reports, including:
    • Potentiometric maps
    • Groundwater plume and free-phase design
    • Geological cross-sections
    • Land use and land cover maps
    • Location alternatives and sensitivity maps
    • Impacted area maps (direct/indirect) - Historical aerial/satellite imagery comparisons
  • Validate topographic data from subcontractors and transform CAD, Google Earth, and PDF layouts into GIS formats.
  • Update and maintain GIS databases and datasets. Develop and publish online maps using ArcGIS Online and Enterprise.
  • Build and deploy field data collection systems using Survey123, Field Maps, and Trimble GPS. Author and edit geoprocessing scripts and tools using Python and ModelBuilder.
  • Promote continuous improvement through automation and innovation in GIS workflows.

Why this role exists

Were at the scaling inflection point. The systems that carried us from Series A to Series C wont carry us to the next stage, and we need someone to own that transition - not just build inside it.


This is a Principal role: youll set technical direction for backend and ML infrastructure across multiple teams, make the architectural calls that are expensive to reverse, and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, mentorship, and the standards you set by example.
